scenario: P1: tempo ate o merge de PRs de autoria de bot versus autoria humana
authentication: token when accepted; anonymous fallback on HTTP 401
unit: hours between pull request created_at and merged_at
inclusion: valid non-negative created_at to merged_at duration
author classified as bot or human
exclusion: observations after the first 30 per group
bot_rule: user.type == Bot or login ends with [bot]; all other authors are human
limitations: GitHub author metadata is an operational proxy for automation
sample is convenience-based and limited to repositories reachable during collection
only recent closed PR pages were inspected
